features.title: Agent toolkit page
features.summary: A main panel (sidebar → Agent toolkit; main-tabs opens it as a tab) showing what the agent can use in one thread: its tools with source (native, plugin, MCP, memory), owner, read-only marker and whether the preset restricts them; the API methods plugins serve each other, with the agent tool each is exposed as; the loaded plugins with versions, state and a link to their settings; MCP servers with status and tools; skills from the project and the user's .agents/skills with who can invoke them; and memory's start block and note counts for the project, with a link to the Memory panel. Search and a source filter narrow every section. It replaces the Tools tab of Settings › Built-in plugins.
failureModes: Without a dshx Host serving the registry, the page says the catalog is unavailable instead of listing nothing.
Without MCP servers or memory loaded, their section says so; the rest still renders.
A registry served by an older dshx lacks read-only, restriction and invocation fields; the page omits those badges and treats skills as user-invocable.

features.title: Open the agent toolkit from the command palette
features.summary: The command palette's “Open the agent toolkit” opens the page about the thread the palette was opened from.
reach: fill textbox "Describe what you want to build, / commands, @ files or sessions" "Toolkit thread"
failureModes: Without a thread the page falls back to global tools.
